name: Lindy
verdict: Team starts at $29.99 per active user a month, and a Slack @mention counts as an active user.
pros: Free start is $50 in credits and needs no credit card
When credits run out, Lindy pauses instead of charging more
Top-up credits last until they are used
cons: Every active user is billed, including Slack @mentions
Monthly credits do not roll over
pricingNote: Prices were checked Oct 17, 2026 (17 October 2026) on https://www.lindy.ai/pricing. Free is $0 and starts with $50 in free credits, with no credit card. The FAQ says those free credits last 7 days. Team is from $29.99 per active user per month, with 3,000 credits each, pooled across the team. Top-ups are $10 per 1,000 credits. Enterprise is Custom, with HIPAA and BAA, SSO and SCIM, and audit logs. Every active user in the workspace is billed, including people who @mention Lindy in Slack. Slack joiners get a 7-day free trial. Direct signups are billed right away. Monthly credits do not roll over. Top-up credits do not expire until used. When credits run out, Lindy pauses. The credit guide on the page says everyday asks are 2 to 250 credits, deep work is 250 to 1,000, and big builds are 1,000 to 2,500.
